description: Return fields from one public page. Call extractors.list for hosts, paths, and the sample schema. You can ask for title, heading, or both. If the page has no extractor, the error points to extractors.list. Call keys.create once. Pass caller_key on every later tools/call.

caller_key.description: pf_ key from keys.create. Pass this on tools/call when Authorization and X-Caller-Key are not set. A header key wins if both are set.

name: extract
title: Extract fields
